name: NYC PolicyScope — Newsletter MVP
description: Reads sample NYC updates, validates structured content JSON, renders HTML preview, saves to output.
notes: Phase 1: Manual trigger, local files only. No live APIs. Each node maps to one step in the pipeline.

nodes.name: Read Sample NYC Updates
nodes.notes: Reads the sample NYC borough updates. In Phase 2, replace with HTTP Request node hitting a real news API.

nodes.name: Read Newsletter Content JSON
nodes.notes: Reads pre-written structured content. In Phase 2, replace with an AI/LLM node that generates this from updates.

nodes.name: Parse Content JSON
nodes.notes: Parses and does basic field presence check. Full JSON schema validation happens in the Python render script.

nodes.name: Render HTML Preview
nodes.notes: Runs the Python render script. Output HTML is saved to /data/output/. Check that file for the result.
